Courage ka matlab darr ka na hona nahi, balki us par jeet haasil karna hai.
Khade raho, bahadur bano.
Jis din hum un cheezon par chup ho jaate hain jo matter karti hain, us din zindagi ka end shuru hota hai.
Khamoshi ki bhi awaaz hoti.
Grit mehnat aur ghisai hai.
Grit chhote roz marra kaam se naapta.
Aantarik shaanti se badi koi taakat nahi hoti.
Bahadur woh nahi jo darta nahi—jo us fear ko conquer kare.
Dobara shuru karne ki himmat.
Suraj ki taraf chehra rakho.
Saat baar giro, aathvi baar phir khade ho jao.
Grit yeh yaqeen hai ki jaari rakh sakte.
Tabhi bolo jab aapka bolna khamoshi se behtar ho.
Tum sab ghatnaon ko control nahi kar sakte, lekin tum apni reaction decide kar sakte ho.
Apne aap se kiye vaade nibhaho.
Humein alag hone ki himmat rakhni chahiye.
Thehraav hi spashtta ki chabi hai.
